gloss: real image; true picture; actual figure

definitions.explanation: In optics, an image formed by converging light rays that can be projected onto a screen. The opposite of a virtual image.

definitions.gloss: true picture; actual figure; real portrait
definitions.explanation: The true, unembellished reality of a person, organization, or situation — as opposed to an idealized or media-constructed image.

examples.japanese: {凸|とつ}レンズで{実像|じつぞう}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: A convex lens produces a real image.

examples.japanese: {実像|じつぞう}はスクリーンに{映|うつ}すことができる。
examples.english: A real image can be projected onto a screen.

examples.japanese: {焦点|しょうてん}{距離|きょり}と{物体|ぶったい}の{位置|いち}によって、{実像|じつぞう}の{大|おお}きさと{向|む}きが{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The size and orientation of the real image change depending on the focal length and the position of the object.

examples.japanese: {歴史上|れきしじょう}の{人物|じんぶつ}の{実像|じつぞう}に{迫|せま}る。
examples.english: To get to the true picture of a historical figure.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}だけでは{企業|きぎょう}の{実像|じつぞう}はわからない。
examples.english: You cannot understand a company's true nature from media reports alone.

examples.japanese: この{伝記|でんき}は{伝説|でんせつ}を{排|はい}し、{偉人|いじん}の{実像|じつぞう}を{丁寧|ていねい}に{描|えが}き{出|だ}している。
examples.english: This biography sets aside legend and carefully depicts the great figure's true character.

notes:
Composed of {実|じつ} (real, actual) and {像|ぞう} (image, figure). The two senses correspond to the literal (optics) and figurative (true nature) meanings of "real image."

The optics sense (sense 1) is standard physics vocabulary taught in middle school. The figurative sense (sense 2) is common in journalism, biography, and cultural criticism — typically paired with verbs like {迫|せま}る (to approach), {描|えが}く (to depict), or {明|あき}らかにする (to reveal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実像|じつぞう}と{虚像|きょぞう}: real image and virtual image (optics); reality and façade (figurative)
- {実像|じつぞう}に{迫|せま}る: to get to the truth of
- {実像|じつぞう}を{描|えが}く: to depict the true picture
- {凸|とつ}レンズの{実像|じつぞう}: real image from a convex lens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {虚像|きょぞう}: virtual image — the opposite in both optics and figurative use
- {実態|じったい}: actual state; true condition — similar figurative meaning but more concrete and data-oriented
- {素顔|すがお}: true face; unmasked self — more personal, about an individual's genuine character
